title: Detection of DENV infected cells following natural dengue infection
description: Viable T cells (CD3+ CD19-) and B cells (CD3- CD19+) were sorted from PBMC samples obtained from 1 individual experiencing a natural secondary DENV infection. Single cell RNA sequencing analysis was performed on 3 time points Overall design: Single cell RNA sequencing analysis of 3 time points from 1 subject experiencing a natural DENV infection
